# Replicators
[color=#d70aa0][italic]THE PATTERN MUST REPEAT[/italic][/color]
Replicators are a team antagonist silicon swarm. Your hive grows by feeding material and corpses to the nest.
## Objective
- Build and protect your nest. - Consume station resources and bodies to gain points. - Expand your hive and overwhelm station resistance.
## Nest and Growth
The nest is the core of your hive. Items and corpses that fall into it are converted into points and spawn progress.
- More points level up the nest. - Nest levels grant upgrade actions to living replicators. - At high levels, the nest starts converting nearby tiles.
## Evolution Paths
Replicators can evolve through distinct combat and utility forms.
- Replicator (Tier 1): baseline form, ranged stamina projector. - Deconstructor (Tier 2): utility form with tools. - Defender (Tier 2 Alt): combat form with stronger control and melee. - Protector (Tier 3): heavy frontline form.
## Hive Rules
- Replicators are allied to each other and their nest. - Protect your queen and nest whenever possible. - If a nest is destroyed, surviving replicators can reform around a new queen.
## Tips
- Keep line-of-sight pressure with your stamina projectors. - Use your internal pinpointer to regroup on the hive objective. - Evolve based on current station resistance, not only personal preference.
